title: Flow
description: A flow.toml file: an end-to-end derivation from an input interface to an output interface, sliced at the boundaries teams own. See docs/flows.md.

sheet.description: Folder of the end-to-end derivation sheet, relative to this file. Default: this folder.

sources.description: Other repositories that interfaces come from, by alias. Refer to their files as "alias:path".

ref.description: Tag or commit to pin; a branch also works but moves.

path.description: A local checkout, relative to this file.

stage.description: Boundaries between input and output, in order.

output.description: The final interface. Its fields are matched to the sheet's send fields.

producer.description: The team that builds the output.

ref.description: An interface file: a path relative to this file, or "alias:path" in a declared source.

carries.description: Which row each field carries, as field = row id. Fields whose name matches a row are matched automatically.

rows.description: Row IDs of the end-to-end sheet computed in this step.

id.description: Short name, used in reports. Default: the interface name.

kind.description: handoff: the next team takes over and only sees what the interface carries (a topic, an event, a fire-and-forget call). call: a request and response; the caller keeps its own state.

producer.description: handoff: the team that produces this interface.

caller.description: call: the team that makes the call.
